findings.title: Fallback locales are loaded only for controller requests
findings.body: This loads the fallback chain only in the controller locale filter. The translation accelerator loads only the active locale, and translations are loaded on demand, so a mailer or background job that sets a non-default locale and calls `I18n.t` without passing through this filter cannot find missing keys in the site-default or English locale. Such calls return missing translations instead of the configured fallback.

findings.title: Changing the site default locale can leave cached translations stale
findings.body: The fallback chain depends on the current `SiteSetting.default_locale`, but the translation accelerator caches results using only the key, active locale, and backend identity. After the site default locale changes, a key missing from the active locale can continue returning the translation from the old default locale until its cache entry is evicted or the process restarts.
